title: Rust in Motion: The Political Environmental Trap of Vehicle Tax Exemptions
title_zh: 运动中的锈迹：车辆免税的政治环境陷阱
title_primary: 运动中的锈迹：车辆免税的政治环境陷阱
title_secondary: Rust in Motion: The Political Environmental Trap of Vehicle Tax Exemptions
authors: Gabriel Facundes Monteiro, Edson R. Severnini
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Transportation is a major source of greenhouse gas and air pollution emissions worldwide, with most automobile pollution coming from vehicles older than 10 years. Yet, many policies discourage the removal of older vehicles from the fleet, with potential consequences for pollution and public health. This paper examines an equity-motivated anti-scrappage policy in Brazil using a border-pair design that exploits state variation in the age thresholds for vehicle ownership tax exemptions. Using municipality-level vehicle registration data from 2013-2020, we find that lower exemption age thresholds increase the average fleet age by up to one year, as they encourage owners to retain vehicles until they qualify for tax exemptions. Using fleet- and satellite-based estimates of pollution and administrative health data, we show that these policies increase on-road CO2 emissions per capita by up to 23% and PM2.5 concentrations by 4%, while deteriorating infant health outcomes. Leveraging state reforms that raised exemption ages, we find evidence that incumbents face greater electoral penalties wherever a greater share of the vehicle fleet re-enters the tax base, consistent with a “political environmental trap.” Within an MVPF framework, we find that lowering the exemption age by five years generates a net welfare loss of $0.78 for every $1 of forgone government revenue.

title: Unveiling the Unseen Illness
title_zh: 揭示隐疾
title_primary: 揭示隐疾
title_secondary: Unveiling the Unseen Illness
authors: Lester Lusher, Tim Ruberg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We utilize region-day variation in actual vs. forecasted weather conditions (i.e. forecasting errors) to comprehensively investigate the effects of the first public warning system for extreme heat events on behavioral and health outcomes in Japan. We find that heat alerts led to a 16% increase in ambulance-related hospital visits. An analysis of mechanisms suggests this is primarily driven by increased awareness and thus reporting of heat strokes that would otherwise have gone undetected, as opposed to substitution in health diagnoses. We further document evidence of avoidance behaviors (e.g. electricity usage).
abstract_zh: 我们利用实际天气状况与预报天气状况之间的区域-日度差异（即预报误差），全面考察了日本首个极端高温事件公共预警系统对行为与健康结果的影响。研究发现，高温预警导致与救护车相关的医院就诊量增加了16%。机制分析表明，这一增长主要源于预警提高了公众意识，从而报告了原本可能未被发现的日射病病例，而非健康诊断上的替代效应。我们还记录了规避行为（如电力使用）的证据。

title: To Change, or Not to Change the Inflation Target: Credibility is the Question
title_zh: 改变通胀目标与否：信誉是关键
title_primary: 改变通胀目标与否：信誉是关键
title_secondary: To Change, or Not to Change the Inflation Target: Credibility is the Question
authors: Gene Ambrocio, Andrea Ferrero, Esa Jokivuolle, Nigel McClung, Kim Ristolainen
official: 官方在线 2026-04-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the tradeoff between a lower frequency of zero lower bound (ZLB) episodes and a loss of credibility for a central bank in relation to an increase of its inflation target. First, we present novel evidence on the relevance of both sides of the tradeoff for changing the inflation target from a survey of economists. Second, we analyze the ZLB-credibility tradeoff in a New Keynesian model featuring an occasionally-binding constraint on the nominal interest rate and a share of agents who form their expectations adaptively, which is negatively related to the degree of credibility of the central bank. For a given level of the inflation target, the ZLB frequency is higher for lower levels of credibility. A target raise aiming to reduce the ZLB frequency may backfire if a simultaneous loss of credibility occurs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了零利率下限（ZLB）事件发生频率降低与中央银行因提高通胀目标而面临的信誉损失之间的权衡关系。首先，我们通过一项针对经济学家的调查，提供了关于改变通胀目标时权衡双方相关性的新颖证据。其次，我们在一个包含名义利率偶尔受限约束及部分适应性预期形成代理人的新凯恩斯模型中，分析了ZLB-信誉权衡，其中适应性预期代理人的比例与中央银行信誉程度负相关。在给定通胀目标水平下，信誉度越低，ZLB发生频率越高。若同时发生信誉损失，旨在降低ZLB频率的目标上调可能适得其反。

title: Consumer Inferences from Product Rankings: The Role of Beliefs in Search Behavior
title_zh: 消费者对产品排名的推断：信念在搜索行为中的作用
title_primary: 消费者对产品排名的推断：信念在搜索行为中的作用
title_secondary: Consumer Inferences from Product Rankings: The Role of Beliefs in Search Behavior
authors: Jessica Fong, Olivia R. Natan, Ranmit Pantle
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In online markets, consumers tend to search and purchase prominently positioned products. We develop an experimental paradigm to distinguish between two mechanisms driving this behavior: position-specific search costs and beliefs about expected returns to search. Using incentivized experiments, we find that both mechanisms exist, and short-term randomization of rankings alone does not separate the two mechanisms. Failing to account for beliefs leads to biased estimates of search costs and incorrect consumer welfare predictions under alternative recommendation systems, such as platform self-preferencing. We discuss solutions for estimating unbiased search costs in real-world search settings. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the UC Berkeley Fisher Center for Business Analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 .
abstract_zh: 在网络市场中，消费者倾向于搜索并购买位于显著位置的商品。我们设计了一种实验范式，以区分驱动这一行为的两种机制：位置特定的搜索成本与对搜索预期回报的信念。通过激励性实验，我们发现这两种机制均存在，且仅靠排名的短期随机化无法将二者区分开来。若未能考虑信念因素，将导致对搜索成本的估计产生偏差，并在替代推荐系统（如平台自我偏好）下得出错误的消费者福利预测。我们探讨了在现实搜索环境中估计无偏搜索成本的解决方案。本文已被Raphael Thomadsen接受，市场营销领域。资助：本研究由加州大学伯克利分校费雪商业分析中心支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00761 获取。

title: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
title_zh: 可替代却被雇佣：自动化与工作的意义
title_primary: 可替代却被雇佣：自动化与工作的意义
title_secondary: Replaceable but Employed: Automation and the Meaning of Work
authors: Joshua S. Gans
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Can automation harm workers without replacing them? We study jobs in which workers value both producing useful output and knowing that the output depends on their own contribution. A credible machine alternative can weaken that second source of meaning even when the firm retains the worker. Our model shows that this loss raises compensation when wages adjust fully; when they adjust only partly, workers bear some of the loss themselves. It can also make automation more likely. An external developer may profit by publicly demonstrating a machine before licensing it, because the demonstration lowers the value of the human alternative. This "meaning externality" can create demand for the machine and make profitable development socially harmful. Better technical quality and greater public salience have different effects: quality improves output, while salience alone weakens human work. Automation can, therefore, reduce the value of work before it eliminates jobs.
abstract_zh: 自动化是否会不通过替代工人而对其造成伤害？我们研究那些工人既重视产出有用成果，又重视成果取决于自身贡献的工作。即使企业保留工人，一个可信的机器替代方案也能削弱第二种意义来源。我们的模型表明，当工资完全调整时，这种损失会提高补偿；当工资仅部分调整时，工人自身需承担部分损失。这还可能使自动化更有可能发生。外部开发者可能通过公开演示机器来获利，即使尚未授权，因为演示降低了人类替代方案的价值。这种“意义外部性”能创造对机器的需求，并使有利可图的开发对社会有害。更好的技术质量和更高的公众关注度具有不同影响：质量提升产出，而仅关注度本身削弱人类工作。因此，自动化可能在消除工作岗位之前就降低工作的价值。

title: DP15 Policy Evaluation and Design for Continuous Time Linear Rational Expectations Models: Some Recent Developments
title_zh: 连续时间线性理性预期模型的政策评估与设计：若干最新进展
title_primary: 连续时间线性理性预期模型的政策评估与设计：若干最新进展
title_secondary: DP15 Policy Evaluation and Design for Continuous Time Linear Rational Expectations Models: Some Recent Developments
authors: Willem Buiter, Benjamin Born, Zeno Enders, Gernot Müller, Rajnish Mehra 等
official: 官方在线 1984-05-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper surveys some recent developments in policy evaluation and design in continuous time linear rational expectations models. Much recent work in macroeconomics and open economy macroeconomics fits into this category. First the continuous time analogue of the discrete time solution method of Blanchard and Kahn is reviewed. Some problems associated with this solution method are then discussed, including non-uniqueness and zero roots. Optimal (but in general time-inconsistent) and time-consistent (but in general suboptimal) solutions are derived to the general linear-quadratic optimal control problem, based on work by Calco, Driffill, Miller and Salmon and the author. A numerical example is solved, involving optimal and time-consistent anti-inflationary policy design in a contract model.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了连续时间线性理性预期模型中政策评估与设计的一些最新进展。宏观经济学与开放经济宏观经济学领域的许多近期研究均属于此类范畴。首先回顾了布兰查德-卡恩离散时间求解方法的连续时间对应形式，继而探讨了该方法相关的若干问题，包括解的非唯一性与零根情形。基于卡尔科、德里菲尔、米勒、萨蒙及作者的研究，推导出一般线性二次最优控制问题的最优解（通常具有时间不一致性）与时间一致解（通常具有次优性）。通过一个数值算例，在合同模型中求解了最优与时间一致的反通胀政策设计问题。

title: Optimal Monitoring in Hierarchical Relationships
title_zh: 层级关系中的最优监督
title_primary: 层级关系中的最优监督
title_secondary: Optimal Monitoring in Hierarchical Relationships
authors: Anke Kessler, Tomaso Duso, Joseph E. Harrington, Jr, Carl Kreuzberg, Geza Sapi 等
official: 官方在线 2000-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies an agency framework in which a principal hires a supervisor to monitor the agent's productive effort. We consider several monitoring technologies which differ in the quantity (frequency) and the quality (accuracy) of the information they deliver. We show that the frequency of monitoring is irrelevant if the supervisor is honest or if the supervisor colludes with the agent but monitoring evidence can only be concealed and not forged. In either case, a first-best can be achieved if monitoring is sufficiently precise even though unbounded punishments are not feasible. Finally, if monitoring evidence can be falsified, the principal benefits both from the frequency and the accuracy of the supervisor's observations. This is the only case in which collusion imposes an additional cost on the relationship. The findings suggest that it is strictly better for the principal to monitor the agent's action rather than testing for an unknown ability or technology parameter.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个委托代理框架，其中委托人雇佣监督者来监控代理人的生产性努力。我们考虑了多种监控技术，这些技术在所传递信息的数量（频率）和质量（准确性）上存在差异。研究表明，如果监督者是诚实的，或者监督者与代理人合谋但监控证据只能被隐藏而无法伪造，那么监控频率无关紧要。在这两种情况下，只要监控足够精确，即使无法实施无限惩罚，也能实现最优结果。最后，如果监控证据可以被伪造，委托人将从监督者观察的频率和准确性中同时获益。这是合谋对委托-代理关系施加额外成本的唯一情形。研究结果表明，对委托人而言，监控代理人的行为严格优于测试其未知能力或技术参数。

title: Quantifying the Half-Life of Deviations from PPP: The Role of Economic Priors
title_zh: 量化购买力平价偏离的半衰期：经济先验的作用
title_primary: 量化购买力平价偏离的半衰期：经济先验的作用
title_secondary: Quantifying the Half-Life of Deviations from PPP: The Role of Economic Priors
authors: Lutz Kilian, Tao Zha, Sibylle Lehmann-Hasemeyer, Fabian Wahl, Francisco Eslava Saenz 等
official: 官方在线 1999-12-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper is a general framework in which alternative priors for the half-life of deviations from PPP can be examined. We show how to incorporate formally the prior views of economists about the half-life. In our empirical analysis we provide two examples of such priors. One example is a consensus prior consistent with widely held views among economists with a professional interest in the PPP debate. The other example is a relatively diffuse prior designed to capture a large degree of uncertainty about the half-life. Our methodology allows us to make explicit probability statements about the half-life and to assess the likelihood that the half-life exceeds a given number of years, without taking a stand on whether the data have a unit root or not. We find only very limited support for the common view in the PPP literature that the half-life is between three and five years.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个通用框架，用于检验购买力平价偏离半衰期的不同先验设定。我们展示了如何将经济学家关于半衰期的先验观点进行形式化整合。在实证分析中，我们提供了两种此类先验的示例：其一是共识先验，与专业关注购买力平价争论的经济学家的普遍观点一致；其二是相对分散的先验，旨在捕捉半衰期的高度不确定性。我们的方法能够在不预设数据是否存在单位根的前提下，对半衰期做出明确的概率陈述，并评估半衰期超过给定年数的可能性。研究发现，购买力平价文献中关于半衰期介于三至五年之间的普遍观点仅获得极为有限的支持。

title: Unconditional Cash Transfers: A Bayesian Meta-Analysis of Randomized Evaluations in Low and Middle Income Countries

title_secondary: Unconditional Cash Transfers: A Bayesian Meta-Analysis of Randomized Evaluations in Low and Middle Income Countries
authors: Crosta, Tommaso, Karlan, Dean, Ong, Finley, Ruschenpohler, Julius, Udry, Christopher
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We use Bayesian meta-analysis methods to estimate the impact of unconditional cash transfers (UCTs). Aggregating evidence from 115 studies of 72 UCT programs in middle and low income countries, we find strong and positive average treatment effects on ten of thirteen outcomes: monthly household total and food consumption, monthly income, labor supply, school enrollment, food security, psychological well-being, total assets, financial assets, and children height-for-age. We examine seven specific theoretical and policy hypotheses, such as presence of savings frictions, dynamic effects, curvature of marginal returns, targeting effects, "nudgeâ€ effects, labor supply elasticity and related "dependencyâ€ theories, and contextual heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 我们采用贝叶斯元分析方法来评估无条件现金转移（UCTs）的影响。汇总来自中低收入国家72个UCT项目的115项研究证据，我们发现，在十三个结果指标中，有十个显示出强烈且正面的平均处理效应：月度家庭总消费和食品消费、月度收入、劳动力供给、学校入学率、食品安全、心理健康、总资产、金融资产以及儿童身高年龄比。我们检验了七个具体的理论和政策假设，包括储蓄摩擦的存在、动态效应、边际回报的曲率、目标定位效应、“助推”效应、劳动力供给弹性及相关“依赖”理论，以及情境异质性。

title: Does Weaker Employment Protection Lower the Cost of Job Loss?
title_zh: 更弱的就业保护会降低失业成本吗？
title_primary: 更弱的就业保护会降低失业成本吗？
title_secondary: Does Weaker Employment Protection Lower the Cost of Job Loss?
authors: Marco Francesconi, Daniela Sonedda
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Leveraging a major Italian reform enacted in July 2012 that eroded employment protection to workers on permanent contracts, we use detailed worker level administrative data to estimate how this reduction affected the cost of job loss. We employ a stacked event-study research design, comparing treated and untreated workers as they move from employment into nonemployment. Weakening employment protection led to additional penalties in terms of lower re-hiring earnings and lower re-employment probabilities. Heterogeneous effects of the reform deepened pre-existing divides, penalizing labor market outsiders, such as young workers, and curbing employment opportunities for individuals in poorer regions, such as the South.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用意大利2012年7月实施的一项重大改革，该改革削弱了对永久合同工人的就业保护，我们采用详细的工人层面行政数据，估计这一削减如何影响失业成本。我们运用堆叠事件研究设计，比较受改革影响与未受影响的工人在从就业转向非就业过程中的差异。就业保护的弱化导致再就业收入降低和再就业概率下降的额外惩罚。改革的异质性效应加深了原有的分化，对劳动力市场边缘群体（如年轻工人）造成不利影响，并限制了较贫困地区（如南部）个体的就业机会。

title: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
title_zh: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？
title_primary: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？
title_secondary: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
authors: Kurt R. Brekke, Odd Rune Straume, Luigi Siciliani
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the impact of public dental care coverage – universal versus targeted – on access, pricing, and public spending in a model with two competing dental practices and heterogeneous patient income groups. We evaluate two types of reimbursement schemes: fixed subsidies and cost sharing. Our findings show that public coverage improves access for low‐income patients but increases producer prices due to reduced price elasticity of demand. Targeted coverage provides greater access at lower public cost compared with universal coverage, especially under cost‐sharing schemes. With fixed subsidies, both schemes achieve similar access, but targeted coverage remains more cost‐efficient. The policy that maximizes utilitarian welfare is targeted coverage with a fixed subsidy, balancing improved access for low‐income patients against higher prices for high‐income patients. This trade‐off highlights challenges in implementing targeted policies but provides insights for designing efficient and equitable public dental care systems.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个包含两家竞争性牙科诊所和异质性患者收入群体的模型中，分析了公共牙科保险覆盖（全民覆盖与定向覆盖）对可及性、定价及公共支出的影响。我们评估了两种报销机制：固定补贴与成本分摊。研究结果表明，公共覆盖改善了低收入患者的可及性，但由于需求价格弹性降低，导致生产者价格上涨。与全民覆盖相比，定向覆盖能以更低的公共成本实现更高的可及性，尤其在成本分摊机制下更为显著。在固定补贴机制下，两种覆盖方案的可及性相近，但定向覆盖仍更具成本效率。实现功利主义社会福利最大化的政策是采用固定补贴的定向覆盖方案，该方案在改善低收入患者可及性与提高高收入患者价格之间取得平衡。这一权衡凸显了实施定向政策的挑战，但为设计高效且公平的公共牙科保险体系提供了启示。

title: Causal Inference for Asset Pricing
title_zh: 资产定价中的因果推断
title_primary: 资产定价中的因果推断
title_secondary: Causal Inference for Asset Pricing
authors: Valentin Haddad, Zhiguo He, Paul Huebner, Péter Kondor, Erik Loualiche
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Portfolio choice involves substituting across many assets at once, complicating inference about asset demand. An elementary condition often captures this behavior in theory and practice: homogeneous substitution conditional on observables (e.g., factor loadings, maturity, credit ratings). We characterize natural experiments identifying demand elasticity and price impact under this condition. Cross-sectional IV and difference-in-differences identify relative elasticity, own- minus cross-price elasticity for assets sharing observables. But a missing-coefficient problem leaves substitution unidentified: the coefficients on observables mechanically absorb it. Identifying substitution requires time-series regressions on portfolios sorted on observables. We apply the framework to corporate bonds, comparing alternative Fed asset-purchase programs.
abstract_zh: 投资组合选择涉及同时跨多种资产进行替代，这使资产需求的推断变得复杂。一个基本条件常在理论和实践中捕捉到这一行为：基于可观测变量（如因子载荷、期限、信用评级）的同质替代。我们刻画了在该条件下识别需求弹性和价格冲击的自然实验。横截面工具变量法和双重差分法可识别相对弹性，即共享可观测变量的资产的自价格弹性减去交叉价格弹性。但缺失系数问题导致替代效应无法识别：可观测变量的系数会机械地吸收替代效应。识别替代效应需要对按可观测变量排序的投资组合进行时间序列回归。我们将该框架应用于公司债券，比较了美联储不同资产购买计划的效果。

title: Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the USA, China, India and South Africa
title_zh: 美国和中国的代际不平等与机会分布研究
title_primary: 美国和中国的代际不平等与机会分布研究
title_secondary: Inherited inequality and the distribution of opportunities in the USA, China, India and South Africa
authors: Brunori, Paolo, Ferreira, Francisco, Salas Rojo, Pedro, Ferreira, Francisco H. G.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Researchers have sought to quantify the extent of inequality that is inherited from previous generations or factors that are predetermined at birth in multiple ways, including a large body of work on intergenerational mobility and inequality of opportunity. Many of the most frequently used approaches to measuring mobility or inequality of opportunity fit within a general framework that involves, as a first step, an estimation of the extent to which inherited personal characteristics can predict current incomes. We suggest a new approach, within that broad framework, that is sensitive to differences across the entire conditional distributions of relevant population subgroups, rather than just in their means. Sensitivity to differences in higher moments of the conditional distributions allows for a comprehensive assessment of inherited inequality. We apply this approach to household income distributions in China, India, South Africa and the USA, to illustrate how the method performs in different settings. We find that inherited inequality accounts for large shares of total inequality, from 36% in the USA to 59% in China, 62% in India, and 81% in South Africa.
abstract_zh: 研究者们一直在尝试从多个角度量化代际传承或出生时既定因素所导致的不平等程度，其中包括大量关于代际流动性和机会不平等的研究。许多常用的衡量流动性或机会不平等的方法，都遵循一个通用框架，其首要步骤是评估继承的个人特征能在多大程度上预测当前收入。我们在此广泛框架内提出一种新方法，该方法关注相关人群子群体整个条件分布上的差异，而不仅仅是均值上的差异。对条件分布高阶矩差异的敏感性，使我们能够全面评估继承性不平等。我们将此方法应用于中国、印度、南非和美国家庭收入分布，以展示该方法在不同情境下的表现。研究发现，继承性不平等占总不平等的比例相当大，从美国的36%到中国的59%、印度的62%以及南非的81%不等。

title: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
title_zh: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例
title_primary: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例
title_secondary: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
authors: Jussi Lintunen, Matti Hyyrynen, Jonathan Holder, Mikko Peltoniemi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the timing of timber harvesting, when neighboring forest stands interact through windthrow risk. Positive adjacency externality stems from the sheltering effect of tall trees whereas negative externality stems from a windthrow-prone border created by clear felling or wind damage. We model wind damages as catastrophic, which call for immediate salvage harvest and regeneration. We augment previous optimal rotation results by extending the analysis to a dynamic harvest policy, where harvest age depends on the age of the neighboring stand. We examine both an efficient equilibrium and an inefficient noncooperative Markov perfect equilibrium. In the efficient equilibrium, where the externality is internalized, harvest is delayed when the neighboring stand is mature. This delay provides shelter by postponing harvest-created border risks. In the noncooperative equilibrium, the shelter is not provided, yet the harvest age adapts to increased risk-levels due to the border effect. We numerically test the magnitude of the border effect under various model assumptions and find that pricing the carbon externality makes the harvest policy more responsive to the adjacency externality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了相邻林分因风倒风险相互作用时，木材采伐时机的选择问题。正向邻接外部性源于高大树木的庇护效应，而负向外部性则源于皆伐或风灾造成的易风倒边界。我们将风灾建模为灾难性事件，要求立即进行救伐和更新。通过将分析扩展至动态采伐政策（其中采伐林龄取决于相邻林分的林龄），我们完善了以往的最优轮伐期研究。我们同时考察了有效均衡和低效的非合作马尔可夫完美均衡。在外部性内部化的有效均衡中，当相邻林分成熟时，采伐会被推迟。这种延迟通过推迟采伐造成的边界风险来提供庇护。在非合作均衡中，庇护效应缺失，但采伐林龄会因边界效应导致的风险水平上升而调整。我们通过数值模拟检验了不同模型假设下边界效应的规模，发现对碳外部性定价会使采伐政策对邻接外部性更加敏感。

title: Catastrophes, Delays, and Learning
title_zh: 灾难、延误与学习
title_primary: 灾难、延误与学习
title_secondary: Catastrophes, Delays, and Learning
authors: Matti Liski, François Salanié
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a simple and general model of experimentation in which reaching untried levels of a stock variable may, after a stochastic delay, lead to a catastrophe. Hence, at any point in time a catastrophe might well be under way, due to past experiments. We show how to measure this legacy of the past from prior beliefs and the chronicle of stock levels. We characterize the optimal policy as a function of the legacy and show that it leads to a new protocol for planning that applies to a general class of problems, encompassing the study of pandemics or climate change. Several original policy predictions follow, e.g. experimentation can stop but resume later.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个简洁且通用的实验模型，在该模型中，当存量变量达到未经尝试的水平时，经过随机延迟后可能引发灾难。因此，在任何时间点，由于过去的实验，灾难可能已经在酝酿之中。我们展示了如何根据先验信念和存量水平的历史记录来衡量这种过去的遗留影响。我们将最优政策刻画为遗留影响的函数，并表明该政策导向一种适用于一般问题类别的新规划协议，涵盖流行病或气候变化研究。由此得出若干原创性政策预测，例如实验可能停止但随后重启。

title: Bad NGOs? Competition in the Market for Donations and Workers' Misconduct
title_zh: 不良非政府组织？捐赠市场竞争与员工不当行为
title_primary: 不良非政府组织？捐赠市场竞争与员工不当行为
title_secondary: Bad NGOs? Competition in the Market for Donations and Workers' Misconduct
authors: Nadia Burani, Ester Manna
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we investigate how competition among NGOs to attract donations shapes the incentives that NGOs provide to their employees. NGOs hire workers to undertake development projects, which are horizontally and vertically differentiated. Workers perform constructive activities that enhance project quality, but can also engage in non‐observable destructive activities that harm the employing organization. NGOs offer monetary incentives to encourage constructive effort, but also need monitoring to curb destructive behavior. Our analysis yields the following results: (i) a high mission orientation on the part of NGOs makes workers' misconduct harder to eliminate; (ii) increased competition in the market for donations leads to higher constructive effort and project quality, but also to greater destructive effort; (iii) relative to the social optimum, the market outcome entails inadequate monitoring and excessive destructive behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非政府组织（NGO）在吸引捐款的竞争如何影响其向员工提供的激励措施。NGO雇佣工人开展发展项目，这些项目在横向和纵向维度上存在差异。工人从事提升项目质量的建设性活动，但也可能进行损害雇佣组织的不可观测的破坏性活动。NGO通过货币激励鼓励建设性努力，同时需要监督机制遏制破坏性行为。分析得出以下结论：（i）NGO的高使命导向使员工不当行为更难以消除；（ii）捐款市场竞争加剧会提升建设性努力和项目质量，但也会增加破坏性行为；（iii）与社会最优水平相比，市场均衡结果表现为监督不足和过度破坏性行为。

title: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
title_zh: 欧盟农业食品政策影响的关键评述
title_primary: 欧盟农业食品政策影响的关键评述
title_secondary: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
authors: Diana Borniotto, Anne-Maud Courtois, Philippe V. Baret
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • Literature on EU agri-food policies show limited and often uneven impacts across dimensions. • Policy effectiveness is highly heterogeneous across Member States and regions. • Compliance, governance, and targeting emerge as key recurring policy challenges. • Lack of outcome-based indicators and data limits evaluation of policy impacts. • Stronger governance is needed to align EU agri-food policies with sustainability. The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare. Using a two-step approach, we first mapped EU-level policies, retaining 38 policies that met predefined criteria (binding EU scope, production-related, impact-oriented, and active since 2000). We then conducted a qualitative synthesis of 97 peer-reviewed studies (from 1.359 retrieved), coding the environmental, social, and economic impacts reported in these studies. Results reveal three systemic weaknesses limiting policy effectiveness across sectors: i) compliance gaps, where high implementation costs and limited enforcement create uneven outcomes across actors and Member States; ii) governance tensions, driven by subsidiarity ambiguities and fragmented decision-making; and iii) targeting deficiencies, where vague objectives reduce effectiveness and accountability. Environmentally, region-specific agri-environmental measures show localized benefits but fail to address systemic pressures like persistent nitrate pollution and delays in pesticide reassessments. Socially, advances in food safety and animal welfare coexist with exclusionary effects, notably the marginalization of small-scale fishers. Economically, compliance costs disproportionately burden smaller operators, while larger actors tend to leverage regulatory complexity and loopholes to their advantages. To overcome these structural challenges, the EU must set clearer objectives aligned with long-term sustainability goals, streamline decision-making responsibilities across governance levels, and implement robust outcome-based monitoring to ensure adaptability and accountability.
abstract_zh: 欧盟农食政策相关文献显示，其影响在各维度上有限且往往不均衡。政策有效性在成员国和地区之间高度异质。合规性、治理和目标定位成为反复出现的核心政策挑战。缺乏基于结果的指标和数据限制了政策影响的评估。需要更强有力的治理来使欧盟农食政策与可持续性目标保持一致。欧盟的农食政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存争议。本研究对关于欧盟初级农业生产政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性综述，聚焦六个领域：共同农业政策、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利。采用两步法，我们首先梳理了欧盟层面的政策，保留了38项符合预设标准（具有约束力的欧盟范围、与生产相关、以影响为导向且自2000年起生效）的政策。随后，我们对97篇同行评审研究（从1，359篇检索文献中筛选）进行了定性综合，并对这些研究报告的环境、社会和经济影响进行了编码。结果揭示了跨部门限制政策有效性的三个系统性弱点：i) 合规缺口，高执行成本和有限执法导致不同行为体和成员国之间结果不均衡；ii) 治理张力，源于辅助性原则模糊性和碎片化决策；iii) 目标定位缺陷，模糊目标降低了有效性和问责性。在环境方面，区域特定的农业环境措施显示出局部效益，但未能解决系统性压力，如持续的硝酸盐污染和农药再评估延迟。在社会方面，食品安全和动物福利的进步与排斥效应并存，尤其是小规模渔民被边缘化。在经济方面，合规成本不成比例地加重了小规模经营者的负担，而较大规模行为体则倾向于利用监管复杂性和漏洞获取优势。为克服这些结构性挑战，欧盟必须设定与长期可持续目标相一致的更清晰目标，理顺各治理层面的决策责任，并实施强有力的基于结果的监测，以确保适应性和问责性。

title: A theory of probabilistic economic equilibria
title_zh: 概率经济均衡理论
title_primary: 概率经济均衡理论
title_secondary: A theory of probabilistic economic equilibria
authors: Juan Jacobo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops an information-theoretic framework that integrates the principle of minimum relative entropy with Bellman’s principle of optimality to formally characterize how purposeful individual behavior gives rise to spontaneous order in market economies. Under standard assumptions from dynamic programming theory, I prove that a probabilistic formulation of Bellman’s equation, subject to an upper bound on relative entropy, admits a unique solution in the form of a dynamic logit function. This function generates a Markov transition with a unique invariant probability distribution, which characterizes economic equilibria as emergent outcomes arising from the purposeful behavior of private agents. I apply these results to neoclassical models of consumption and investment, illustrating that the theory can effectively account for key cross-sectional and time-series properties of economic systems.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个信息论框架，将最小相对熵原理与贝尔曼最优性原则相结合，以正式刻画有目的性的个体行为如何在市场经济中催生自发秩序。在动态规划理论的标准假设下，我证明了在相对熵上界约束下的贝尔曼方程的概率形式化表述，具有唯一解，该解表现为动态逻辑函数形式。此函数生成一个具有唯一不变概率分布的马尔可夫转移，从而将经济均衡刻画为私人主体有目的性行为涌现出的结果。我将这些结果应用于新古典消费与投资模型，说明该理论能有效解释经济系统中的关键横截面与时间序列特征。

title: Is daily Chinese institutional trading and stock price volatility positively correlated?
title_zh: 中国机构每日交易与股价波动是否正相关？
title_primary: 中国机构每日交易与股价波动是否正相关？
title_secondary: Is daily Chinese institutional trading and stock price volatility positively correlated?
authors: Zhijuan Chen, Wei Liu, Changfeng Ma, Shunming Zhang
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Aggregate trading by Chinese institutional investors, trading for mutual funds and private funds are positively associated with stock volatility. In contrast, the dealers trading exhibits a negative association with stock volatility. These results highlight heterogeneity in the impact of institutional trading on stock volatility. The relationship between Chinese institutional investor trading and stock volatility is time-varying, differing significantly between bull and bear market periods. We find no evidence that the unexpected components of mutual funds and private funds trading convey more information than their expected components. Our findings suggest that Chinese institutional investors do not possess an informational advantage and are unable to stabilize the market.
abstract_zh: 中国机构投资者的总体交易行为，包括共同基金和私募基金的操作，与股票波动性呈正相关。相反，券商交易则与股票波动性呈负相关。这些结果凸显了机构交易对股票波动性影响的异质性。中国机构投资者交易与股票波动性之间的关系随时间变化，牛市与熊市期间存在显著差异。我们未发现证据表明共同基金和私募基金交易的意外成分比其预期成分传递了更多信息。我们的研究结果表明，中国机构投资者并不具备信息优势，且无法稳定市场。
